# Variable selection, run end to end

*Generated by `creditsurv select`. Every number comes from this run.*

## What was run

Steps 5 to 9 of `docs/variable_selection.md`, on the training half of the whole
population up to 2021-12, under the `exclude` moratorium policy:
**72,671,500 cells covering 2,112,532,468 loan-months**, with no sampling
at any step.

Two departures from the first run, both to keep the backtest honest. The selection sees
only the training half, because a specification chosen on the months the model is judged
on has already seen the test. And stability is judged across loans originated in even and
in odd years -- two halves that each cover every calendar month -- rather than across the
whole population and its first 94%, which needs the test window.

## Chosen

`credit_score + original_ltv + debt_to_income + term_years + ltv_change + unemployment_change + policy_rate_change + consumer_sentiment + housing_starts_growth + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat'))`

|---|---|
| Corporate bond spread | step 6: variance inflation 10.8, above 10 |
| Equity return | step 8: reversed sign: -0.03437 in the full model, +0.5181 beside the loan block alone |
| Equity volatility | step 8: wrong sign: +0.009258 where - is expected |
| Financial conditions | step 10: 1 sd effect +0.0060 on log survival time, under 0.02 |
| House price growth | step 8: wrong sign: -0.1719 where + is expected |
| Inflation change since origination | step 8: reversed sign: -0.03472 in the full model, +13.81 beside the loan block alone |
| Inflation | step 8: reversed sign: -8.994 in the full model, +8.431 beside the loan block alone |
| Mortgage rate fall since origination | step 9: 1 sd effect -0.065 on even and +0.004 on odd origination years, beside policy_rate_change (+0.136), both interest rates |
| Volatility change since origination | step 8: wrong sign: +0.0003651 where - is expected |
| Yield curve slope | step 9: 1 sd effect -0.066 on even and +0.014 on odd origination years, beside policy_rate_change (+0.125), both interest rates |

### 10. Materiality

A macro covariate whose effect of one standard deviation on log survival time is under
0.02 in absolute value contributes its sign and little else, and a covariate
that small changes sign when the sample does. The threshold is fixed in `docs/rules.md`,
before any of these fits, and the removals are made one at a time because each one moves
every other coefficient.

**One covariate a step, the smallest first**

| Step | Removed | Effect of one sd | Threshold | Remaining |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Financial conditions | 0.0060 | 0.0200 | 14 |
